customFont.comment: Global keyboard font row label, shown in the Settings tab and as the font-picker title (font is a global setting, not a per-theme field). Shared by iOS, Android and macOS (the macOS candidate-window font picker).

customThemesSection.comment: Section header above the custom-theme shelf in the theme picker.

createNewTheme.comment: Label + content description for the create-new-theme card on the theme picker shelf.

familyClassic.comment: Built-in theme key-style family header: filled keys.

familyFramed.comment: Built-in theme key-style family header: transparent keys with an outline border.

familyClean.comment: Built-in theme key-style family header: transparent keys, no border.

paletteDefault.comment: Built-in theme color name: the adaptive default palette (value = 'Default'). DRAFT TL/POJ (ī-siat, full dict main reading) + en/ja pending USER proofread.

palettePink.comment: Built-in theme color name: soft pink gradient (value = 'Sakura' / cherry blossom). DRAFT TL/POJ (ing-hue, full dict entry) + en/ja pending USER proofread.

paletteGold.comment: Built-in theme color name: golden gradient (value = 'Gold'). DRAFT TL/POJ (金 kim + 煌 hông, component-grounded) + en/ja pending USER proofread.

paletteBlue.comment: Built-in theme color name: blue gradient (value = 'Sea Breeze'). DRAFT TL/POJ (hái-hong, full dict entry) + en/ja pending USER proofread.

paletteGreen.comment: Built-in theme color name: green gradient (value = 'Jade' / jade green). DRAFT TL/POJ (翠 tshuì + 青 tshing, component-grounded) + en/ja pending USER proofread.

palettePurple.comment: Built-in theme color name: purple gradient (value = 'Wisteria'). DRAFT TL/POJ (藤 tîn + 紫 tsí, component-grounded) + en/ja pending USER proofread.

paletteCatppuccin.comment: Built-in theme color name: the dark-only Catppuccin Mocha palette. Hanji 暗眠山貓 is a pun (山貓=mountain cat≈cat, 暗眠=dark sleep≈dark mode). DRAFT TL/POJ (暗 àm + 眠 bîn + 山貓 suann-niau, component-grounded) + en/ja pending USER proofread.

keyboardSection.comment: Theme editor section header: the keyboard-surface group (background color + key height).

colorKeySection.comment: Theme editor section header: the key-surface group (key colors + sizing).

candidateSection.comment: Theme editor section header: the candidate-bar group (candidate colors + text size).

colorKeyboardBackground.comment: Theme editor color-row label: the keyboard background color.

colorKeyText.comment: Theme editor color-row label: the key glyph (text) color.

colorNormalKeyFill.comment: Theme editor color-row label: the fill color of normal (letter) keys.

colorSpecialKeyFill.comment: Theme editor color-row label: the fill color of special (function) keys.

colorCandidateText.comment: Theme editor color-row label: the candidate text color.

colorCandidateBackground.comment: Theme editor color-row label: the candidate-bar background color.

keyHeight.comment: Theme editor slider label: keyboard height scale.

keyFontSize.comment: Theme editor slider label: key glyph font size.

candidateTextSize.comment: Theme editor slider label: candidate text size. Also the macOS 外觀 pane's candidate text-size picker label — same property, same settings-row role.

keyCornerRadius.comment: Theme editor slider label: key corner radius.

keyBorderWidth.comment: Theme editor slider label: key border width.

keyShadow.comment: Theme editor slider label: key shadow intensity.

editorTitleNew.comment: Theme editor top-bar title in create mode.

editorTitleEdit.comment: Theme editor top-bar title in edit mode.

editorSave.comment: Theme editor / name dialog save button.

editorResetAll.comment: Reset-to-defaults button. Theme editor on Android and iOS; the macOS shortcuts pane reuses it for the same action.

defaultName.comment: Fallback name when a theme is saved with a blank name (identity is the UUID; names may repeat and stay editable).

cardMenuApply.comment: Custom-theme card action-menu item: apply this theme.

cardMenuEdit.comment: Custom-theme card action-menu item: edit this theme.

capReachedTitle.comment: Title of the alert shown when the custom-theme count cap (5) is reached.

values.tailo: í ta̍t tsú-tê sòo-liōng siōng hān
values.poj: í ta̍t chú-tê sò͘-liōng siōng hān
values.ja: テーマ数の上限に達しました

capReachedMessage.comment: Body of the custom-theme cap-reached alert (cap is UserThemeStore.MAX_USER_THEMES = 5).

values.hanji: 自訂主題上限是 5 个，請先刪除一个才會使閣新增。
values.tailo: tsū-tīng tsú-tê siōng hān sī 5 ê, tshiánn sian san-tî tsi̍t-ê tsiah ē-sái koh sin-tsing.
values.poj: chū-tēng chú-tê siōng hān sī 5 ê, chhiáⁿ sian san-tî chi̍t-ê chiah ē-sái koh sin-cheng.
values.en: You can save up to 5 custom themes. Delete one before adding another.
values.ja: カスタムテーマは 5 個まで保存できます。追加する前に 1 個削除してください。

cardMenu.comment: Accessibility content description for the custom-theme card's action-menu button. Android-only (iOS has no equivalent a11y label).

colorPickerGrid.comment: Color picker dialog tab label: the swatch-grid picker. Android-only (iOS uses a native color picker).

colorPickerSpectrum.comment: Color picker dialog tab label: the spectrum picker. Android-only.

colorPickerSliders.comment: Color picker dialog tab label: the RGB sliders picker. Android-only.

colorRed.comment: Color picker RGB slider label: red channel. Android-only.

colorGreen.comment: Color picker RGB slider label: green channel. Android-only.

colorBlue.comment: Color picker RGB slider label: blue channel. Android-only.
